calculation.expression: -sum_{i=0..2}(return_{t-i}) when 20-day mean cross-asset return dispersion exceeds its trailing 120-day median; otherwise 0; cross-sectionally demean
calculation.description: Fade the recent three-session move only when cross-asset volatility dispersion is elevated. All returns and the regime gate use information available through the prior completed session; the persisted signal artifact is the audit source.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-instrument synthetic cross-asset universe with at least 8 valid names per date. Elevated-dispersion gating yields 1,165 valid daily observations; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is small. Deterministic library-correlation audit remains authoritative.
